goal.insight: Show the complete ML infrastructure pipeline from data ingestion through monitoring, making the sequential flow from Data Platform → Feature Store → Training Cluster → Model Registry → Inference Service → AB Experiment Platform → Monitoring & Alerting visually prominent as a directed architecture

Encode node type via color (data-layer=blue, compute-layer=green, serving-layer=orange, observability-layer=red), node size by criticality score, edge thickness by data throughput volume, and edge style (solid for primary data flow, dashed for version-control/lineage links)

Visually distinguish the data lineage and version control connections as a secondary overlay network that cross-cuts the primary pipeline flow, connecting the Version Control node to Feature Store, Model Registry, and Training Cluster
Emphasize the branching at the Inference Service layer where the pipeline splits into online (real-time) and offline (batch) inference paths before converging at the AB Experiment Platform
Highlight the feedback loop from Monitoring & Alerting back to the Data Platform and Training Cluster, showing the closed-loop nature of the ML operations cycle
